# Net protocol · PROTO_VER 1

Invite code: `^\d{8}$` (display `NNNN NNNN`) = trystero roomId = password · appId `hordegrid/p1`

## PlayerInput(u16)
| bits | name | values |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 | move | 0 none, 1 N, 2 NE, 3 E, 4 SE, 5 S, 6 SW, 7 W, 8 NW, 9–15 invalid→0 |
| 4 | fire | level |
| 5 | place | level |
| 6 | strafe | level (touch: auto while fire) |
| 7 | weapon_next | level (edge detected in sim) |
| 8 | weapon_prev | level |
| 9–14 | reserved | must be 0 |
| 15 | present | 1 for any live local input; 0 = GGRS default/disconnected |

## Game channel wire frame (DataChannel `ggrs`, negotiated id 101, unordered, maxRetransmits 0)
`[u8 proto_ver=1][postcard(ggrs::Message)]` · max 1200 B · decode failure → drop + counter

## take_outbox framing (wasm → JS, per tick)
repeat: `[u8 slot][u16 len LE][len bytes]`

## Lobby messages (trystero action `lobby`, JSON)
| type | fields | sender |
|---|---|---|
| knock | name ≤16, protoVer, buildHash | new peer → host |
| admit | peerId | host → all |
| deny | reason: 'rejected' \| 'timeout' \| 'full' | host → new peer |
| rehost | code: string(8 digits) | host → admitted members |
| hello | name ≤16, protoVer, buildHash | admitted peers |
| ready | ready: bool | each |
| kick | target: PeerId | host |
| start | players: PeerId[] (sorted), seed: u32, mapId: u8 | host |
